claim.scope_statement: A precise report of Andersen–Han–Li–Mistegård–Sauzin–Sun, arXiv:2510.10678v1, Theorem 1.1, for its Seifert integral homology-sphere family. The theorem-to-Puiseux implication and all-order remainder are explained, and the inputs with exceptional multiplicities (2,3,6n+1), n>=1, are verified explicitly. This is a credited preprint theorem, not an independently reproduced proof.
